finalproject

Yumin Min’s final project for Harvard BST260, Fall 2026.

This repository contains an R package and its accompanying project website. The website infrastructure is in place; the project proposal and analyses are under development.

Installation 

install.packages("devtools") # if needed
devtools::install_github("Mint0o01/finalproject")
data("waterborne", package = "finalproject")

Building the website

Install the Quarto command-line tool and the R packages pkgdown and quarto. From the repository root, run:

pkgdown::build_site()

Commit the generated docs/ directory to main. GitHub Pages publishes the site from the /docs folder on that branch.

Course resources

This project is based on Vincent Carey’s BST260 project template. The instructor’s instructions and project suggestions are retained as reference articles.

Contact: ymin1@hsph.harvard.edu.
